name: edm-uniform-100x1000-v1
policy_usage: Actor weights only, for data collection. All evaluated denoisers train from scratch.
split_unit: Entire reset episode, with disjoint reset seeds
terminal_policy: Drop the terminal transition because upstream max pooling can return stale terminal pixels; no terminal model is evaluated
checkpoint_selection: Final scheduled update; no test-based tuning
metrics: MSE and mean per-frame PSNR on [0,1] RGB
Correct-versus-random action PSNR with shared sampling noise
limitations: Two Atari games; generator evaluation, not RL benchmark reproduction
Policy-collected data inherits the pretrained policies' coverage
Long rollouts use episodes with sufficient remaining length; eligible cohort is reported
Action ablation is a sensitivity measure, not causal counterfactual accuracy
Pixel metrics are not a substitute for semantic correctness
No FVD or game-over model evaluation
Earlier test results have been inspected; final checkpoint selected by fixed update budget, not test metrics.
validation: Epoch 1, every 10 epochs, and final epoch; fixed windows, RNG restored afterward.
checkpointing: Current checkpoint each epoch; retained agent snapshots every 10 epochs; final scheduled weights evaluated.
